mentions.name: pi
mentions.description: An AI agent built entirely on Cloudflare Workers that can be spun up with just an inference key, providing a file view, a ChatGPT-like experience, the ability to build and host custom apps, and alarms that wake it up to perform plain-language tasks. The author is exploring how to package it and where it would be useful for other apps.
mentions.source_excerpt: It started with building pi in the cloud - with pure cloud flare workers. I have it working now, and can spin up - the  wrangler agent can fully run it as long as you pass it an inference key, including a file view, a chatgpt like experience, and ability to build and host custom apps. Can use alarms to wake up to do plain language tasks, etc.
